comparison: User encoder-only map versus a fresh EKF survey; separate runs, not a repeated-trial ranking.
ekf_inputs: wheel forward velocity and zero lateral velocity; IMU angular velocity z. No truth or absolute IMU yaw.
pose_evaluation_scope: Recorded after the first outbound waypoints; includes later stationary samples. Not full-route pose coverage.
mapping_metric: One-way distance of occupied cells to scene-box surfaces; no completeness guarantee.
